title: Piano touch, Bix and Stacy
summary: Ashcraft jokes that he and Bix sounded like they used the sustaining pedal, and admires Stacy's tone.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: we used to Bix and I used to laugh about one personal tragedy that we each we shared and that is that some pianos sound always as if they're using the loud pedal the sustaining pedal well they are not it's a question of touch entirely and the piano is an awful funny Rube Goldberg instrument anyhow with mallets and levers and springs and things and why this happens I don't know but Bix and I both sounded and always have sounded as if we had the loud pedal on neither of us ever touch it
his records don't sound too much that way but he can play a very good piano
and he sounds as if he's playing a bad one
maybe too legato for the average jazz purpose
it might be that but the difference in tone that one guy can get in another can't on that funny instrument has always baffled me three notes of Stacy you know it is
Did Stacey in any way imitated Hines? Or just felt it?
No, I know that he always, I know that he thought the world of him, that's all I know. We have now even talked about it.
